Login fixed: the client now sends the login this server answers, so everyone lands in the creation hall again. Main menu backdrop recomposed and full width. Launcher flags MCM Helper light so load orders match the server. Per person settings no longer ride in packs.

Updates reach your game again, and the main menu is only the Thornswood backdrop. Since the move to the Steam copy the launcher had been marking every update as installed without writing a single game file, so nobody got the login fix or the backdrop. Launcher 1.1.32 puts the missed updates back in the queue and installs them properly the next time it opens. The first time it has a lot to download, so give it a while, or run the installer from the site instead. The main menu is now the Thornswood backdrop on any screen, with no buttons, no logo, no save panel and no animation replacer banner, and the game walks you into the creation hall by itself.

Voice works: the game finds the launcher's microphone again, so the indicator leaves LISTENING ONLY and push to talk reaches the launcher. Emote wheel is back on G, the key file had been cut down to the field of view line. SkyHUD config restored, the incompatible config popup is gone. Door fix: the rescue that pulled you back through the inn door is off. Thornswood's plugins stay idle when the client points at another server, so they no longer draw over Keizaal Online. New main menu art. Launcher checks in with the character's own profile id and logs its own faults. Vortex bookkeeping and face exports no longer ship in updates.

Voice indicator fixed for real: the page inside the game was still the old one and never took the launcher's state. Switching servers without touching Vortex: the launcher now keeps its own copies of the twelve files in Data\Platform it owns, puts back any that another server's launcher changed before every Play, and parks any other server's plugin while Thornswood runs, then puts it back the moment the game closes. Start menu entry for the launcher on every machine. Site downloads line corrected to https.
Discord shows you playing Thornswood, with Download and Discord buttons. A dev build you can install from Settings, on its own server. Each build keeps its own game files.
Dev build for the Owner and Dev roles only, voice port per build, session note for the plugins, other servers' files stay out of releases
The launcher holds its files while the game runs, so another launcher opened mid-session cannot change them. Save folder problems no longer stop Play and say why.
A Downgrade button on the Play page: Steam fetches 1.6.1170 and the launcher puts it in place, nothing to paste. The build line says which build Skyrim is on.

Scan checks every plugin's bytes against the server and Fix fetches the server's copy (the LOAD ORDER ERROR one machine had), Start On Save can no longer load a single player save under SkyMP (the crash on a fresh install with old saves), difficulty is Expert, the Downgrade button clicks into Steam's console before it types

- Dates read month first with a time on them

news.title: The launcher now tells you when your mod collection is out of date.
news.body: It reads which revision of the Thornswood collection you have installed and compares it with the newest one. If you are behind, it says so before you press Play instead of letting you join and fail on a load order mismatch. This is the half that was missing from the update a few minutes ago. That one asked you to update to revision 5; this one is the launcher that can actually check. Nothing else changed. If you already updated your collection, you will see nothing new.

news.title: The mod list has a new revision, and the world has started over.
news.body: Before you press Play, update the Thornswood collection in Vortex to revision 5. The launcher tells you if you have not. Taken out: Tavern Games, Respawn - Death Overhaul and SunHelm Survival, which did not work on this server. Immersive Armors is now the script free version. New: Playable Rieklings, with RaceCompatibility. The collection now carries the plugin order, so let Vortex sort and do not move plugins by hand. Because the load order changed, everybody makes a new character, and every house and farm is unclaimed again.
details: The load order moved, so start a new character or expect the old save to complain

news.title: The launcher sends its logs for you, and a session that went wrong is marked
news.body: When something breaks, nobody will ask you to go and find four files any more. The launcher sends its own log and the game's logs when you close the game, and again at the next start if it was killed before it could. Chat is now written down too, with a name and a time, so a report about something somebody said can be answered by reading it instead of asking both people. Voice is not recorded and nothing reads your machine.
details: Bug reports no longer start with being asked for log files
Chat is kept for a year and only moderators can read it. See the Rules page
The launcher puts a new mod load order in place by itself instead of asking you to press Fix
The theme plays on every build now. Settings, Music turns it off

news.title: The launcher sends its logs when you close the game, so nobody has to ask you for them
news.body: When a session ends, the launcher sends its own log and the game's logs to the site. That is the only moment it can: the game wipes those files every time it starts, which is why every bug report so far has begun with somebody being asked to go and find four files. If the launcher is killed or the game takes it down, the logs go at the next start instead. Nothing you type is in them and they are the launcher's own files, not yours.
details: Nobody will be asked to find and paste log files for a bug report any more
A session that crashed is marked, so it can be found without reading forty of them
A session stopped by a failed update or a wrong load order is marked separately
Logs are kept for a year, and only for sessions the launcher actually reported

If an update moves the mod load order, the launcher now puts the new list in place by itself instead of letting the game turn you away and expecting you to work out that Fix was the answer.
